dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……かったりい」
dialogues.en: "Hah... this sucks."
dialogues.text: "Hah... this sucks."

dialogues.jp:
教員棟の階段を上りながら、何度目かの溜め息
を漏らす。
dialogues.en:
Walking up the stairs next to the staff room, I let out a
heavy sigh.
dialogues.text:
Walking up the stairs next to the staff room, I let out a
heavy sigh.

dialogues.jp:
食堂での騒動が落ち着いて、にゅるにゅるになっ
たうどんをやっと食べようかという時に、暦先
生に｛つか／捉｝まってしまった。
dialogues.en:
With the commotion in the cafeteria over, I was just about
to start on my noodles again, when Koyomi-sensei caught me.
dialogues.text:
With the commotion in the cafeteria over, I was just about
to start on my noodles again, when Koyomi-sensei caught me.

dialogues.jp:
音夢に、にゅるにゅるうどん――略してにゅる
どん――の処理を任せて、俺は泣く泣く仰せつ
かった任務に従事することにしたのだ。
dialogues.en:
I forlornly began to carry out the duty Koyomi-sensei
assigned to me, as Nemu handled the "cleaning up" of my
lunch.
dialogues.text:
I forlornly began to carry out the duty Koyomi-sensei
assigned to me, as Nemu handled the "cleaning up" of my
lunch.

dialogues.jp: 暦先生のご用命を――断れるはずが無い。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi's request are special--there's no possibility of
refusing more than once, as you won't live to do so.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi's request are special--there's no possibility of
refusing more than once, as you won't live to do so.

dialogues.jp:
「……ったく、それにしたって鍵ぐらい自分で
　返せっての」
dialogues.en: "...Blegh, I have to return the key myself as well."
dialogues.text: "...Blegh, I have to return the key myself as well."

dialogues.jp:
用事があるという暦先生は、俺に備品室のキー
を預け、さっさと帰ってしまったのだ。
dialogues.en:
Task done, I prepare to head back and return the key to the
equipment room to Koyomi.
dialogues.text:
Task done, I prepare to head back and return the key to the
equipment room to Koyomi.

dialogues.jp: 「しかもなんで最上階にあるんだよ、管理室！」
dialogues.en:
"And of course the management room has to be on the top
floor!!"
dialogues.text:
"And of course the management room has to be on the top
floor!!"

dialogues.jp: かったる。
dialogues.en: Sucks.
dialogues.text: Sucks.

dialogues.jp:
俺は惰性で階段を上り、『開閉禁止』と書かれ
た鉄の扉を開ける――て、扉？
dialogues.en:
With the momentum from climbing all those stairs, I open the
iron door with the "No Entry" sign on it...wait, door?
dialogues.text:
With the momentum from climbing all those stairs, I open the
iron door with the "No Entry" sign on it...wait, door?

dialogues.jp: 俺はどこまで来てるんだ！？
dialogues.en: Where the hell have I gone!?
dialogues.text: Where the hell have I gone!?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「お姉ちゃん、ポン酢ちょうだい」
dialogues.en: "Sis, the ponzu please."
dialogues.text: "Sis, the ponzu please."

dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ありがと」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp: 「大根もいる？」
dialogues.en: "How about some daikon?"
dialogues.text: "How about some daikon?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ううん、いい」
dialogues.en: "Mm, okay."
dialogues.text: "Mm, okay."

dialogues.jp: 「そう。じゃあ、白菜入れるね」
dialogues.en: "Alright, then I'd throw in the hakusai as well."
dialogues.text: "Alright, then I'd throw in the hakusai as well."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: なんですか……これは？
dialogues.en: What...is this?
dialogues.text: What...is this?

dialogues.jp: 偶然、訪れた場所で行われている団らん。
dialogues.en: There's a weird group in the place I'm at.
dialogues.text: There's a weird group in the place I'm at.

dialogues.jp: １、実はこれは夢
dialogues.en: 1. This is actually a dream.
dialogues.text: 1. This is actually a dream.

dialogues.jp: ２、屋上の扉は、実は『どこかへドア』だった
dialogues.en: 2. The rooftop door is actually a door to anywhere.
dialogues.text: 2. The rooftop door is actually a door to anywhere.

dialogues.jp: ３、女の子が屋上で鍋を食べている現実の風景
dialogues.en:
3. What I see before my eyes is true; two girls are on the
rooftop eating from a steampot.
dialogues.text:
3. What I see before my eyes is true; two girls are on the
rooftop eating from a steampot.

dialogues.jp: 「大穴やなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Low odds, I suppose..."
dialogues.text: "Low odds, I suppose..."

dialogues.jp: 独りボケつっこみに、世間と屋上の風は冷たい。
dialogues.en: As I stood there dumbfounded, a cold wind blew past.
dialogues.text: As I stood there dumbfounded, a cold wind blew past.

dialogues.jp:
目の前では、クラスメイトの眞子と、あまり見
覚えの無い女の子――制服からして本校の学生
だと思われる――が、食事をしていた。
dialogues.en:
In front of me, was my classmate Mako and a girl I didn't
know -- wearing the uniform of the main school -- enjoying
lunch.
dialogues.text:
In front of me, was my classmate Mako and a girl I didn't
know -- wearing the uniform of the main school -- enjoying
lunch.

dialogues.jp:
キャンプで使うようなテーブルにコンロ、鍋の
中には、お肉や野菜がグツグツ、グツグツ……。
dialogues.en:
There was a table with a cooking stove, the kind used for
camping. On it was a pot with meat and vegetables,
simmering.
dialogues.text:
There was a table with a cooking stove, the kind used for
camping. On it was a pot with meat and vegetables,
simmering.

dialogues.jp: 屋上で弁当……これはよくある。だが……。
dialogues.en: Boxed lunches eaten at the rooftop, I've heard of. But...
dialogues.text: Boxed lunches eaten at the rooftop, I've heard of. But...

dialogues.en: "(Steampots... at the rooftop?)"
dialogues.text: "(Steampots... at the rooftop?)"

dialogues.jp: なぜ、鍋？
dialogues.en: Why a steampot?
dialogues.text: Why a steampot?

dialogues.jp: ――ガンッ
dialogues.en: --*Bang*
dialogues.text: --*Bang*

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あっ」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
ドアから手が離れ、背後で重い扉が音を立てて
閉まる。
dialogues.en:
I let go of the doorknob, and the door made a loud bang
behind me as it shut itself.
dialogues.text:
I let go of the doorknob, and the door made a loud bang
behind me as it shut itself.

dialogues.jp:
ようやく俺に気づいたふたりとの間に、一瞬の
沈黙が流れる。
dialogues.en:
Once they noticed it was me though, the moment of
uncomfortable silence disappeared.
dialogues.text:
Once they noticed it was me though, the moment of
uncomfortable silence disappeared.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「もう、驚かせないでよ……」
dialogues.en: "Geez, don't frighten me like that..."
dialogues.text: "Geez, don't frighten me like that..."

dialogues.jp: 眞子が驚きさめやらぬ表情で声を漏らす。
dialogues.en:
Mako's face was a mixture of surprise and agitation, as she
muttered those words.
dialogues.text:
Mako's face was a mixture of surprise and agitation, as she
muttered those words.

dialogues.jp: 「……なに、してるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "...What, are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "...What, are you doing?"

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、俺はありきたりな質問を眞子に投
げかけてみる。
dialogues.en: I throw the first, most obvious question at Mako.
dialogues.text: I throw the first, most obvious question at Mako.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「お昼食べてるの」
dialogues.en: "Eating lunch, duh."
dialogues.text: "Eating lunch, duh."

dialogues.jp: 昼？　冬に？　こんな所で？
dialogues.en: Lunch? In the winter? Here?
dialogues.text: Lunch? In the winter? Here?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なによ」
dialogues.en: "What's with that weird look?"
dialogues.text: "What's with that weird look?"

dialogues.jp:
まじまじと見つめる俺に、眞子が｛いぶか／訝｝しげな表情
をする。
dialogues.en: Mako stared at me with a suspicious expression.
dialogues.text: Mako stared at me with a suspicious expression.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、このくそ寒い中、アホかな――と」
dialogues.en: "Well, in this stupidly cold weather, only idiots wou-"
dialogues.text: "Well, in this stupidly cold weather, only idiots wou-"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なんですってっ！」
dialogues.en: "What was that?!"
dialogues.text: "What was that?!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「言っとくけど、あたしがしてる訳じゃないか
　らね。あたしはお姉ちゃんに付き合ってるだ
　けだから」
dialogues.en:
"Think before you open your mouth. I'm here to meet my
sister."
dialogues.text:
"Think before you open your mouth. I'm here to meet my
sister."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「お姉ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "Sister?"
dialogues.text: "Sister?"

dialogues.jp: 部活の先輩かと思ってたら、家族だったのか。
dialogues.en:
I thought she looked like a senior from her club activities,
but apparently they're related.
dialogues.text:
I thought she looked like a senior from her club activities,
but apparently they're related.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そ。お姉ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, sister."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, sister."

dialogues.jp: そう言って、隣に座っている女の子を指差す。
dialogues.en: She pointed to the girl sitting next to her.
dialogues.text: She pointed to the girl sitting next to her.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの、｛みずこし／水越｝｛もえ／萌｝と言います。宜しくお願いしま
　すね」
dialogues.en: "Um, I'm Mizukoshi Moe. Nice to meet you."
dialogues.text: "Um, I'm Mizukoshi Moe. Nice to meet you."

dialogues.jp:
眞子の隣で、俺たちのやり取りを眺めていた女
の子が、ご丁寧にぺこりと頭を下げる。
dialogues.en:
The girl sitting next to Mako, and in the middle of our
conversation, politely bowed towards me.
dialogues.text:
The girl sitting next to Mako, and in the middle of our
conversation, politely bowed towards me.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、どうも。朝倉[name]です」
dialogues.en: "Ah, same here. I'm Asakura [name]."
dialogues.text: "Ah, same here. I'm Asakura [name]."

dialogues.jp: 俺も軽く頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: I lower my head slightly, in a short bow.
dialogues.text: I lower my head slightly, in a short bow.

dialogues.jp: 「何度か見かけたことがありますよ」
dialogues.en: "I've seen you around quite a few times before, I think."
dialogues.text: "I've seen you around quite a few times before, I think."

dialogues.jp:
というか、いつかどこかで、話したこともあっ
たような気もするようなしないような……。
dialogues.en:
Although saying that, we haven't exactly spoken to each
other...
dialogues.text:
Although saying that, we haven't exactly spoken to each
other...

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「え？　そうでしたか？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh? Really?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh? Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「……ごめんなさい……ポケポケしてて覚えて
　ないです」
dialogues.en: "...I'm sorry... I don't remember. I'm a bit slow."
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry... I don't remember. I'm a bit slow."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "Ahh... I'm really sorry."
dialogues.text: "Ahh... I'm really sorry."

dialogues.jp: 申し訳なさそうにペコリと頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: She sorrowfully bowed her head in apology.
dialogues.text: She sorrowfully bowed her head in apology.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、覚えてないならいいです」
dialogues.en: "Oh, no, it's okay if you don't remember."
dialogues.text: "Oh, no, it's okay if you don't remember."

dialogues.jp:
そんな頭を下げられたら、こっちまで恐縮して
しまう。
dialogues.en:
To be so apologetic for something as insignificant as that,
made me feel ashamed for even bringing it up.
dialogues.text:
To be so apologetic for something as insignificant as that,
made me feel ashamed for even bringing it up.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なにナンパしてんのよ」
dialogues.en: "Wow, just met and already flirting?"
dialogues.text: "Wow, just met and already flirting?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「お前は、今の会話のどこをどう聞いてナンパ
　にワープするんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Where and how exactly was that flirting?"
dialogues.text: "Where and how exactly was that flirting?"

dialogues.jp:
それにしても、眞子に姉がいたとは……意外だ。
てっきり、一人っ子だとばかり思っていた。
dialogues.en:
In any case, Mako has a sister... that's surprising. She's
always seemed like an only child to me.
dialogues.text:
In any case, Mako has a sister... that's surprising. She's
always seemed like an only child to me.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「で、あんた何しに来たの」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, why did you come here?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, why did you come here?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いや、俺は偶然通りかかっただけなんだが」
dialogues.en: "Nothing, I just accidentally came here."
dialogues.text: "Nothing, I just accidentally came here."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「どうやって偶然、屋上に通りかかれるのよ」
dialogues.en: "How exactly do you "accidentally" come to the rooftop?"
dialogues.text: "How exactly do you "accidentally" come to the rooftop?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「人生色々だ。よしとしようじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Human nature. No reason or cause for it."
dialogues.text: "Human nature. No reason or cause for it."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……あんたと話すとホント、疲れるわ」
dialogues.en: "Haah... just talking with you makes me tired."
dialogues.text: "Haah... just talking with you makes me tired."

dialogues.jp:
眞子がぐったりと肩を落とす。どうも俺と話す
奴は、途中で元気がなくなる。
dialogues.en:
Mako's shoulders dropped limply, as if somehow talking to me
made her lose her energy.
dialogues.text:
Mako's shoulders dropped limply, as if somehow talking to me
made her lose her energy.

dialogues.jp: 一部、例外はいるが……。
dialogues.en: I guess that could be part of it.......
dialogues.text: I guess that could be part of it.......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「眞子ちゃんのお友達だったんですね」
dialogues.en: "So you're Mako's friend."
dialogues.text: "So you're Mako's friend."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes..."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ドアが閉じたときは、もう私ビックリしてし
　まいました」
dialogues.en: "You really frightened me when you closed that door."
dialogues.text: "You really frightened me when you closed that door."

dialogues.jp:
ビックリしたというわりには、ニコニコと微笑
んで、なんだかおっとりとした口調で言う。
dialogues.en:
She says she's frightened with a kind smile, complete
opposites.
dialogues.text:
She says she's frightened with a kind smile, complete
opposites.

dialogues.jp: ……不思議な人だ。
dialogues.en: ...A very curious person.
dialogues.text: ...A very curious person.

dialogues.jp: 「それにしても、なんでこんな所で鍋を？」
dialogues.en: "So, why bring the steampot here?"
dialogues.text: "So, why bring the steampot here?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「眞子ちゃんが教室じゃダメだと言うので」
dialogues.en: "Mako said that we shouldn't do this in a classroom."
dialogues.text: "Mako said that we shouldn't do this in a classroom."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あたりまえでしょう。教室でなんか食べれる
　わけないじゃない」
dialogues.en: "Of course! The classroom isn't a place for eating.
dialogues.text: "Of course! The classroom isn't a place for eating.

dialogues.jp: 呆れたように言う眞子。
dialogues.en: Mako's words tinged with indignance.
dialogues.text: Mako's words tinged with indignance.

dialogues.jp: （なんだか凄い姉妹だな）
dialogues.en: "(What an amazing pair of sisters.)"
dialogues.text: "(What an amazing pair of sisters.)"

dialogues.jp:
とんでもないことをしでかしそうな姉と、それ
をフォローしまくりの妹……。
dialogues.en:
The older sibling who says something outrageous, and the
younger sister who quickly rebutts it...
dialogues.text:
The older sibling who says something outrageous, and the
younger sister who quickly rebutts it...

dialogues.jp: （なんか、どこかで見たような関係だな）
dialogues.en: "(Hmm, I feel like I've seen this before...)"
dialogues.text: "(Hmm, I feel like I've seen this before...)"

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、わざわざこんな寒いところじゃなく
　ても……部室とかは使えないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"But, such a cold place for doing this sort of thing...
couldn't you use one of the club rooms?"
dialogues.text:
"But, such a cold place for doing this sort of thing...
couldn't you use one of the club rooms?"

dialogues.jp: やはり、何か隠れてするとしたら部室に限る。
dialogues.en: And why not any other place for that matter...
dialogues.text: And why not any other place for that matter...

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「音楽部の部室＝音楽室だもん。無理に決まっ
　てるじゃん」
dialogues.en:
The music club's room isn't exactly a place to mess around
in."
dialogues.text:
The music club's room isn't exactly a place to mess around
in."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩は？」
dialogues.en: "And Moe's?"
dialogues.text: "And Moe's?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「私も音楽部ですから」
dialogues.en: "I'm also in the music club."
dialogues.text: "I'm also in the music club."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、先輩も音楽部なんだ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, in the music club as well."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, in the music club as well."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「眞子はフルートだよな」
dialogues.en: "Mako's a flutist, right?"
dialogues.text: "Mako's a flutist, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まぁね」
dialogues.en: "Yep."
dialogues.text: "Yep."

dialogues.jp:
前に聴いたことがあるけど、カスタネットとか
トライアングル専門の俺が聞く限りでも、かな
り上手かった。
dialogues.en:
Besides the flute, I've heard from others that she's pretty
good with the triangle and castanets as well.
dialogues.text:
Besides the flute, I've heard from others that she's pretty
good with the triangle and castanets as well.

dialogues.jp:
吹いている姿が｛りり／凛々｝しいって、女子に人気があ
るぐらいだからな。
dialogues.en:
Girls always seem to prefer the elegance of a wind
instrument, though.
dialogues.text:
Girls always seem to prefer the elegance of a wind
instrument, though.

dialogues.jp: 「先輩は何です？」
dialogues.en: "Moe, what about you?"
dialogues.text: "Moe, what about you?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「私は木琴です」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I play the xylophone."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I play the xylophone."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「へぇ、木琴ですか」
dialogues.en: "Heeeh, the xylophones eh..."
dialogues.text: "Heeeh, the xylophones eh..."

dialogues.jp: ｛さすが／流石｝に同じ楽器はやってないか。
dialogues.en: As expected, not the same instrument.
dialogues.text: As expected, not the same instrument.

dialogues.jp:
腕前のほどは分からないけど、やっぱ眞子のお
姉さんだけあって、上手いんだろうか？
dialogues.en:
I'm not sure of her skill, but if she's Mako's sister,
surely she must be quite good?
dialogues.text:
I'm not sure of her skill, but if she's Mako's sister,
surely she must be quite good?

dialogues.en: --*hiss*
dialogues.text: --*hiss*

dialogues.jp: グツグツグツ――
dialogues.en: --*sputsputsput*
dialogues.text: --*sputsputsput*

dialogues.jp:
テーブルの上では、かなりいい感じでお鍋が煮
えている。
dialogues.en:
On the tabletop, the steampot's contents look like it's been
boiled to perfection.
dialogues.text:
On the tabletop, the steampot's contents look like it's been
boiled to perfection.

dialogues.jp:
にゅるどんを食べ損ねた俺の腹も、負けずにい
い感じで減っている。
dialogues.en:
My stomach, still lamenting the loss of it's nyuru-don,
easily lost to the smell and rumbled.
dialogues.text:
My stomach, still lamenting the loss of it's nyuru-don,
easily lost to the smell and rumbled.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "...That's rude."
dialogues.text: "...That's rude."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「仕方ないだろうが、｛・・／色々｝あって昼飯を食べてい
　ないんだから」
dialogues.en: "It can't be helped. I didn't manage to eat lunch today."
dialogues.text: "It can't be helped. I didn't manage to eat lunch today."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの、よかったら一緒に食べませんか？」
dialogues.en: "Um, then could you eat with us?"
dialogues.text: "Um, then could you eat with us?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「え、いいんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Eh, is that alright?"
dialogues.text: "Eh, is that alright?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「はい。お鍋は大勢で囲った方がおいしいです
　から」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. The more people eating from a steampot, the more
delicious it is."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. The more people eating from a steampot, the more
delicious it is."

dialogues.jp:
優しく微笑みを浮かべる萌先輩。表情負けしな
い、優しい心をもった人だ。
dialogues.en:
Moe gave a gentle smile with her words, and I lost to it
instantly. Definitely a kind-hearted girl.
dialogues.text:
Moe gave a gentle smile with her words, and I lost to it
instantly. Definitely a kind-hearted girl.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、それじゃあお言葉に甘えて」
dialogues.en: "In that case, I gratefully accept."
dialogues.text: "In that case, I gratefully accept."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Please do."
dialogues.text: "Please do."

dialogues.jp: 俺の前に箸と皿が差し出される。
dialogues.en: She handed out a pair of chopsticks and a plate to me.
dialogues.text: She handed out a pair of chopsticks and a plate to me.

dialogues.jp: （予備？）
dialogues.en: "(A spare?)"
dialogues.text: "(A spare?)"

dialogues.jp: いったい、何人分の食器があるんだ？
dialogues.en: Just how many sets of tableware does she have?
dialogues.text: Just how many sets of tableware does she have?

dialogues.jp:
他にもテーブルの上には、グツグツ煮える鍋、
ポン酢と大根おろしと、錠剤のビンが置かれて
いた。
dialogues.en:
On the table, along with the simmering pot, ponzu and grated
daikon, was a bottle of pills.
dialogues.text:
On the table, along with the simmering pot, ponzu and grated
daikon, was a bottle of pills.

dialogues.jp: 「錠剤？　風邪でも引いているんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Pills? Do you have a cold?"
dialogues.text: "Pills? Do you have a cold?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、これは栄養剤なんです……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, these are nutrient pills..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, these are nutrient pills..."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「栄養剤？」
dialogues.en: "Nutrient pills?"
dialogues.text: "Nutrient pills?"

dialogues.jp:
こんな立派な昼食を食べてるのに、とてもそん
なのが必要には思えないんだけど……。
dialogues.en:
For such an elaborate lunch, they don't really seem to be
required...
dialogues.text:
For such an elaborate lunch, they don't really seem to be
required...

dialogues.jp: （もしかして、答えにくい薬なのかな）
dialogues.en: ("Maybe they're a different type of medicine...)"
dialogues.text: ("Maybe they're a different type of medicine...)"

dialogues.jp:
……よく分からないが、女の子だと色々とある
みたいだからな。
dialogues.en:
...I don't really understand, but that's typical of women I
suppose...
dialogues.text:
...I don't really understand, but that's typical of women I
suppose...

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ鍋、ありがたく頂きますね」
dialogues.en: "Well then, thank you for the meal."
dialogues.text: "Well then, thank you for the meal."

dialogues.jp:
深くはツッこまないことにして、そそくさと鍋
に箸をのばす。
dialogues.en: I plunged my chopsticks into the pot.
dialogues.text: I plunged my chopsticks into the pot.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "It's okay."
dialogues.text: "It's okay."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いつもここで食べてますから、よかったらま
　たいらして下さい」
dialogues.en: "Feel free to come here to eat lunch whenever you want."
dialogues.text: "Feel free to come here to eat lunch whenever you want."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっ、いいんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Wow, is that really okay?"
dialogues.text: "Wow, is that really okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Of course."
dialogues.text: "Of course."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「是非！」
dialogues.en: "By all means!"
dialogues.text: "By all means!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は素晴らしい提案を、もちろん快諾する。
dialogues.en: I immediately consented to the wonderful invitation.
dialogues.text: I immediately consented to the wonderful invitation.

dialogues.jp:
さようなら、これまでの機械生産な食べ物たち。
こんにちは、これからの愛情溢れる手料理たち。
dialogues.en:
Farewell, my old days of vending machine lunches. Welcome,
my new days of love-filled home-cooking!
dialogues.text:
Farewell, my old days of vending machine lunches. Welcome,
my new days of love-filled home-cooking!

dialogues.jp:
俺はこれからの両手に花（？）な昼休みを妄想
し、空の皿を持ったまま表情をほぐす。
dialogues.en:
With the thought of two flowers (?) beside me every day for
lunch, I lifted my plate into the air with joy.
dialogues.text:
With the thought of two flowers (?) beside me every day for
lunch, I lifted my plate into the air with joy.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Haah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah..."

dialogues.jp:
眞子の溜め息が、人知れず鍋の煮える音にかき
消された。
dialogues.en:
Mako's sigh was quickly drowned out by the sound of the
simmering steampot.
dialogues.text:
Mako's sigh was quickly drowned out by the sound of the
simmering steampot.

dialogues.jp: ◆屋上への招待状◆
dialogues.en: ◆Invitation to the Rooftop◆
dialogues.text: ◆Invitation to the Rooftop◆

dialogues.jp:
偶然、屋上に通りかかったところ、クラスメイ
トの水越眞子と謎の先輩に出会う。
dialogues.en:
Surprisingly, when I visited the rooftop, I met my classmate
Mizukoshi Mako, with a mysterious senior.
dialogues.text:
Surprisingly, when I visited the rooftop, I met my classmate
Mizukoshi Mako, with a mysterious senior.

dialogues.jp:
なんでも眞子のお姉さんで萌という名前だそう
だが……それにしてもなんで屋上で鍋を？
dialogues.en:
Apparently it was Mako's older sister, Moe... and what about
the pot at the rooftop?
dialogues.text:
Apparently it was Mako's older sister, Moe... and what about
the pot at the rooftop?

dialogues.jp:
まあ、可愛い先輩と知り合いになれたことだし、
その上これからも鍋をご馳走してくれるってこ
とだし、気にしなくてもいいか。
dialogues.en:
Well, after meeting a cute senior and enjoying a pot feast,
that's more or less insignificant.
dialogues.text:
Well, after meeting a cute senior and enjoying a pot feast,
that's more or less insignificant.
